suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as infection neurologic complication. Require documented Lyme neuroborreliosis or clinically attributable neurologic Lyme disease and separately documented facial nerve (cranial nerve VII) palsy. PMID 35064770 should not be generalized to other cranial neuropathies. Uncomplicated Lyme disease without neurologic involvement does not satisfy this relationship. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
